content:
[L] high | SLA nav tab, top-left | The "SLA" tab label is overlapped/collided with by the mouse cursor, obscuring the text — tab label unreadable at its active state.
[L] high | SLA by mailbox table, rightmost column | "WAITING OLDEST (MIN)" values (14580, 1500) are right-aligned hard against the table's right edge with no padding, visually clipped against the column border.
[S] high | SLA by mailbox table columns | Column headers are spaced with huge uneven gaps and content is inconsistently aligned — IN RANGE/FR AVG values center-float with no column grid, numbers drift relative to headers.
[S] med | Top-right range pills | The four range options (1 year / 90 days / 30 days / 7 days) have inconsistent spacing and mismatched treatments — one filled black pill among plain text links with uneven gaps.
[S] med | Warning banner vs First response card | Gap between the two floating cards is much smaller than the gap between the first card and the header, creating uneven vertical rhythm in the left card stack.
[S] med | Persisted breach tracking form | "Billing / Support" sub-tab labels are indented differently from the "First response hours" / "Resolution hours" labels below, breaking left-edge alignment within the card.
[H] med | Whole page | Nearly every heading and label uses the same weight and size (Reports, card titles, section titles, tab labels), so nothing reads as primary vs secondary.
[H] med | SLA by mailbox table | Header row is ALL-CAPS small gray text while values are mixed bold and plain (bold 0/0 vs plain —), with no consistent pairing of header to value emphasis.
[C] med | Right half of upper screen | A large empty dead zone stretches to the right of the warning and First-response cards while all content is crushed into the left column and bottom cards.
[C] med | Persisted breach tracking card | The two form inputs float far left inside a ~1400px-wide card, leaving ~1000px of unused whitespace to their right; footnote text runs full-width beneath.
[C] low | Bottom footnote | Long technical run-on sentence ("deduped per conversation and kind…") at tiny gray size reads as developer debug copy, not product UI.
[C] low | "0 recorded breach event(s)" chip | Raw "(s)" suffix and technical phrasing is system-speak rendered as a prominent blue chip at equal weight to real data.
[H] low | Sync now button vs range pills | "Sync now" is styled as a bordered button while adjacent controls are bare text; inconsistent control treatment in the same toolbar row.

VERDICT: unprofessional — broken label collision, unpadded table edges, uneven column grid, half-empty screen with debug-grade copy, and no typographic hierarchy anywhere.
